_note: Applied corrections to the adopted design baseline. 'awaiting-evidence' items were deliberately NOT applied.

applied.evidence: POCO M5 is MediaTek Helio G99 = MT6765. mt6789 is Dimensity 1080. AGENTS.md 'Project Overview'.

An earlier revision of this script changed 2408 to 2400 on the strength of a
remembered spec sheet. The operator's on-device measurement contradicts it:
the panel really is 2408 px tall. Reverted; see
deliverables/m20/rock-display-measurement.md.
0x40078000 is the mt6789 kernel load address. Carrying it into an mt6765 BoardConfig would produce an unbootable image with no obvious cause.
5 of 6 measurable Liquid Glass fields disagreed with the measured Apple kit. scripts/compare-glass-tokens.py. ours matches the kit on all six.

Every screen-level fullscreen blur radius in the incoming file (values 30-60) had no measured counterpart. A sibling key states the provenance inline so no reader can mistake one for Apple's, and the value itself is preserved. A JSON sibling key rather than a /* comment */ because these blocks are parsed as JSON and JSON has no comment syntax.
Re-adopting the rounded rect walks back a measured fix. See AppleuxSuperellipse.kt and AppIconView.kt.
Two top-level elements declared the identical rect {0.021,0.55,0.31,0.35}. Detected by duplicate-frame scan over the extracted screens.

411x916 is an iPhone figure and is 9.6 dp wider than this panel. The earlier
revision used 411.43 x 914.29, derived from a wrong 2400/420 assumption.
`figmaKitReachable: true` is true only for the token path, false for the anonymous-HTTP path this spec itself exercised.

These URLs return HTTP 404 (lock-screen.png and control-center.png tested). They were constructed, not observed. The local Apple guide screenshots are the real reference; the filename mapping is a guess and is marked as one.
The spec undercounted its own inventory by ~40%.
